name: Studio source contract

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  verified-source:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    env:
      PYTHONUTF8: "1"
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: "1"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
      - name: Verify complete reviewed Git delivery and protected component
        run: python studio/tools/studio_delivery_contract.py --root .
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "24"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: studio/package-lock.json
      - name: Install frontend dependencies from lockfile
        working-directory: studio
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
      - name: Install hashed Linux Python CI wheels without dependency expansion
        run: python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --only-binary=:all: --no-deps --require-hashes -r studio/requirements-ci-linux.txt
      - name: Verify installed dependency versions and closure
        working-directory: studio
        run: python tools/studio_ci_dependencies.py --root .
      - name: Install local project without unpinned build dependencies
        run: python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --no-deps --no-build-isolation -e './studio[test]'
      - name: Check Python dependency consistency
        run: python -m pip check
      - name: Test Python and worker contracts
        working-directory: studio
        run: python -m pytest -q
      - name: Compile reviewed Python sources
        working-directory: studio
        run: python -m compileall -q api core tools Slicer-Server packages deploy/homeassistant/custom_components/ultimate_3d_studio
      - name: Check TypeScript
        working-directory: studio
        run: npm run typecheck
      - name: Test frontend contracts
        working-directory: studio
        run: npm test
      - name: Build frontend in isolated output
        working-directory: studio
        run: npm run build
      - name: Verify source identities remain unchanged after tests
        run: python studio/tools/studio_delivery_contract.py --root .

"""Synthetic version/closure checks; no package download or installation."""
import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
import pytest
from packaging.markers import default_environment

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("studio_ci_dependencies", ROOT/"tools/studio_ci_dependencies.py")
contract = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
SPEC.loader.exec_module(contract)

@pytest.fixture
def graph():
    pins = "\n".join(name+"==1.0" for name in sorted(contract.ROOTS))
    installed = {name: {"version": "1.0", "requires": []} for name in contract.ROOTS}
    env = dict(default_environment(), python_version="3.13", python_full_version="3.13.0", sys_platform="linux")
    return pins, installed, env

def test_complete_exact_versions_pass(graph):
    text, installed, env = graph
    assert contract.verify(text, installed, env)["packages"] == 5

@pytest.mark.parametrize("line", ["aiohttp>=1", "aiohttp==1.*", "aiohttp===1.0",
                                  "aiohttp[test]==1.0", "aiohttp @ https://example.invalid/a.whl"])
def test_ranges_wildcards_extras_and_urls_fail(graph, line):
    text, installed, env = graph
    text = text.replace("aiohttp==1.0", line)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError): contract.verify(text, installed, env)

def test_duplicate_even_inactive_pin_fails(graph):
    text, installed, env = graph
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        contract.verify(text+'\naiohttp==1.0; sys_platform == "win32"', installed, env)

@pytest.mark.parametrize("mutation", ["missing", "version"])
def test_installed_drift_fails(graph, mutation):
    text, installed, env = graph
    if mutation == "missing": installed.pop("pytest")
    else: installed["pytest"]["version"] = "2.0"
    with pytest.raises(ValueError): contract.verify(text, installed, env)

@pytest.mark.parametrize("requirement", ["missing>=1", "aiohttp>=2", "aiohttp[test]>=1",
                                        "aiohttp @ https://example.invalid/a.whl"])
def test_missing_or_incompatible_transitive_dependency_fails(graph, requirement):
    text, installed, env = graph
    installed["pytest"]["requires"] = [requirement]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError): contract.verify(text, installed, env)

def test_windows_only_dependency_is_checked_only_on_windows(graph):
    text, installed, env = graph
    text += '\ncolorama==1.0; sys_platform == "win32"'
    installed["pytest"]["requires"] = ['colorama>=1; sys_platform == "win32"']
    assert contract.verify(text, installed, env)["packages"] == 5
    env["sys_platform"] = "win32"
    with pytest.raises(ValueError): contract.verify(text, installed, env)
    installed["colorama"] = {"version": "1.0", "requires": []}
    assert contract.verify(text, installed, env)["packages"] == 6

@pytest.mark.parametrize("key,value", [("python_version","3.12"),("sys_platform","darwin")])
def test_unreviewed_environment_is_rejected(graph,key,value):
    text, installed, env = graph
    env[key]=value
    with pytest.raises(ValueError): contract.verify(text, installed, env)

def test_extra_dependencies_do_not_enter_default_closure(graph):
    text, installed, env = graph
    installed["setuptools"]["requires"] = ['unused>=1; extra == "test"']
    assert contract.verify(text, installed, env)["verified"]

def test_required_root_cannot_be_silently_dropped(graph):
    text, installed, env = graph
    with pytest.raises(ValueError): contract.verify(text.replace("wheel==1.0",""), installed, env)

# Python dependencies for source CI

Source CI uses CPython 3.13. requirements-ci.txt pins runtime, test and editable-build dependencies to the inspected PC versions, including their active transitive dependencies: 18 packages on Windows and 17 on Linux. colorama is Windows-only.

Linux CI installs requirements-ci-linux.txt with --require-hashes, --only-binary=:all: and --no-deps. Each of its 17 entries permits exactly one downloaded and SHA-256-verified PyPI wheel for Linux x86_64 or a platform-independent wheel. Selected native wheels use CPython/abi3 and manylinux tags with a glibc baseline no newer than 2.28. Other architectures and unavailable artifacts fail; no source-build fallback is enabled.

The dependency contract checks installed versions and active dependency closure against requirements-ci.txt. The local project is then installed with --no-deps --no-build-isolation, and pip check validates the environment. setuptools and wheel are included in the hashed Linux pin set.

Run from the Studio source directory:

    python tools/studio_ci_dependencies.py --root .

## Verified artifact evidence

On 14 October 2026, all 17 wheels (5,397,901 bytes total) were fetched from files.pythonhosted.org using version-specific metadata from https://pypi.org/pypi/<package>/<version>/json. Downloaded sizes and SHA-256 values matched that metadata. Wheel names, package versions, compatibility tags and active Requires-Dist closure were checked without importing package code. Metadata is integrity evidence, not an independent signed provenance attestation.

An offline pip dry run selected all 17 verified wheels. A separate wrong-hash fixture was rejected. Neither check installed packages or ran Linux code. Raw metadata, wheel archives and private reports remain outside Git delivery.

## Remaining acceptance boundaries

A clean Linux install, actual ABI/runtime behavior, remote GitHub CI and complete source/profile license review remain open. Windows uses version pins only; the Linux artifact lock is not a Windows wheel lock. No engine, plugin, base image or OS-package lock is implied. Previously granted licenses and the narrower Slicer-Server license scope remain unchanged.

The dependency checker only reads metadata and files. It does not install packages, contact services, run an engine or operate a printer. The workflow has no deployment step.
